### States and Transitions

The layer is a small state machine on **layer 3**, plus a second axis, the `PauseGate` mode. It owns no simulation state: every state below is host-local presentation state (CT-27), none is in a snapshot, and after any `request_restore` the machine is rebuilt from CLOSED (TX-27). The kernel column is shown for SOLO; in OVERLAY every in-session cell reads `RUNNING`. **No guard in either table reads the kernel column** *(Amended 2026-10-27 — re-review)* (TX-38's former guard did and is rewritten); guards read `web.view`, `save_status`, `SaveInfo` / `campaign_info()`, `PauseGate` (`mode`, `can_save_quit`) or host-local state (CT-4).

#### States

| State | Entry | Exit | Transitions (see the table below) | Who may cause them |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `BOOT_NOTICE` | boot with no `notice_seen` in the store, or an unreadable store (CT-19, CT-20) | dismiss | TX-1 | the player (dismiss, or the two toggles inline); the store (flag absent) |
| `MAIN_MENU` | boot with the notice seen; dismiss; FAULTED in release (CT-26); `cancel` from UI-5; `cancel` from Display & Comfort (TX-37); a `new_game` failure result (TX-34) *(Amended 2026-10-27 — design review)* | Continue; New campaign; Display & Comfort; Quit | TX-3..TX-6, TX-12, TX-30, TX-34 (entry), TX-36, TX-37 (entry) | the player; Save/Load (failure results, via `LOAD_HOLD`); the kernel (FAULTED return) |
| `UI5_NEW_OVER_EXISTING` | New campaign with an existing campaign (CT-24) | Retire (hold); Delete (longer hold); `cancel` *(Amended 2026-10-27 — re-review)* | TX-7, TX-8, TX-12 | the player |
| `UI8_NO_LOADABLE` | `continue_campaign()` returns `SL_LOAD_NO_LOADABLE_SAVE` (CT-25; TX-11, from `LOAD_HOLD`) *(Amended 2026-10-27 — design review)* | New campaign; Quit | TX-5, TX-6 (when a campaign exists), TX-30 | the player; Save/Load (result) |
| `UI9_INCOMPATIBLE` | `continue_campaign()` returns the incompatible-build result (CT-25; TX-11, from `LOAD_HOLD`) *(Amended 2026-10-27 — design review)* | New campaign (TX-5, never via UI-5); Quit (TX-30) | TX-5, TX-30 | the player; Save/Load (result) |
| `LOAD_HOLD` *(Amended 2026-10-27 — design review: exits added)* | the load sequence (CT-42) step 1 (TX-4, TX-5, TX-9) *(Amended 2026-10-27 — re-review)* | **exits: TX-33** (the first `RUNNING` frame, a camera `CUT`, to `CLOSED`); **TX-11** (a Continue failure result to `UI8_NO_LOADABLE` or `UI9_INCOMPATIBLE`); **TX-34** (a `new_game` failure or any other failure result, to `MAIN_MENU`, items re-enabled) | entries TX-4, TX-5, TX-9; exits TX-11, TX-33, TX-34 | the player (the accept that started it); Save/Load (result); not this layer's content: layer 1 black is the pipeline's, with no text |
| `CLOSED` | in-session `chart_table`/Resume/`cancel` at depth 1; TX-33 (the first `RUNNING` frame after a load); any restore; TX-35 (`cancel` on a console-opened chart) *(Amended 2026-10-27 — design review)* | `chart_table`; a no-pick console press at a prompt that opens the chart (CT-10); both are governed raises (CT-3 re-open governor) | TX-13, TX-14, TX-18 | the player (`chart_table`); the Input Adapter's console seam (CT-10); a restore closes any other state into it (TX-27) |
| `PANEL` | `chart_table` from CLOSED (TX-13, governed); `cancel` from CHART (origin `PANEL`), DISPLAY_COMFORT (origin `PANEL`) or a message plate | Chart; Display & Comfort; Save & Quit; Resume; `chart_table`; `cancel` | TX-15..TX-17, TX-19..TX-21, TX-24 | the player |
| `CHART` | Chart from PANEL with `transit_state == IDLE` (entry origin `PANEL`, TX-16); a console press that opens the chart (entry origin `CONSOLE`, TX-18); both governed raises *(Amended 2026-10-27 — design review)* | `cancel` (to `PANEL` if the origin is `PANEL`, TX-19; to `CLOSED` if the origin is `CONSOLE`, TX-35); `chart_table`; `transit_state` leaving IDLE | TX-15, TX-16, TX-18, TX-19, TX-28, TX-35 | the player; `web.view` (a `transit_state` change) |
| `CHART_VIEW_ONLY` | Chart from PANEL with `transit_state != IDLE` (origin `PANEL`); TX-28 (keeps the origin of the `CHART` it came from) | `cancel` (by origin, as `CHART`); `chart_table`; `transit_state` returning to IDLE while open (TX-29, to CHART with focus on HOME) | TX-15, TX-19, TX-29, TX-35 | the player; `web.view` |
| `DISPLAY_COMFORT` | Display & Comfort from PANEL (origin `PANEL`, TX-20); Display & Comfort from `MAIN_MENU` (origin `MAIN_MENU`, TX-36) *(Amended 2026-10-27 — design review)* | `cancel` (to `PANEL` by TX-19, or to `MAIN_MENU` by TX-37); `chart_table` (in-session only; a boot-flow origin ignores it, CT-5) | TX-15, TX-19, TX-36, TX-37 | the player; the store (applied-mode read-back; live relayout, focus kept by item id) |

| `SAVE_FAILED` | `save_status == FAILED` or the held-write timeout (TX-23). It is the PANEL with the plain word `FAILED` in the panel's status-line position (CT-17); the four items stay in CT-3 order | Resume; Chart; Display & Comfort; `chart_table`; Save & Quit (to `UI3_PLATE`) | TX-15..TX-17, TX-20, TX-25 | the player; Save/Load (`save_status`) |
| `UI3_PLATE` *(Amended 2026-10-27 — re-review)* | Save & Quit refused with `SL_QUIT_NO_WRITE_DOWNED` (TX-24); Save & Quit accepted from `SAVE_FAILED` (TX-25); Save/Load's window-close handler refused with `SL_QUIT_NO_WRITE_DOWNED` (TX-38) *(Amended 2026-10-27 — design review)* | `cancel` to PANEL (TX-19); `chart_table` to CLOSED (TX-15, SOLO resume); Retry (where offered) to `SAVE_QUIT_WAIT` (TX-32); press-and-hold Quit without saving to `HOLD_CONFIRM` (TX-31) | TX-15, TX-19, TX-25, TX-31, TX-32 | the player |
| `HOLD_CONFIRM` (sub-state) *(Amended 2026-10-27 — re-review)* | press-and-hold on the destructive item of `UI3_PLATE` (TX-31) or `UI5_NEW_OVER_EXISTING` (Retire, TX-7; Delete, TX-8) | fill reaches 1 (TX-9, TX-26); release / `cancel` / `chart_table` / focus loss returns to the screen that owns the item (TX-10) | TX-7..TX-10, TX-26, TX-31 | the player only (the layer's UI clock advances the fill, CT-43) |

The `PauseGate` axis: **SOLO (MVP)** calls `request_pause` on CLOSED to PANEL or CHART (TX-13, TX-18; both governed raises, applied together with the plate, CT-3) and `request_resume` on any in-session state to CLOSED (TX-15, TX-35; lowers are never delayed) *(Amended 2026-10-27 — design review)*. **OVERLAY (VS-B, reserved)** makes no kernel call (TX-14); `can_save_quit` is Session / Save-Load's. Every other row is identical in both modes.

865	### D.10 Layer-3 draw-call estimate
866	
867	The layer-3 draw-call estimate formula is defined as:
868	
869	`D_L3 = (CHART_RING_STEPS + 1) + D_filament + 3 * N_nodes + D_pod + D_route + D_seam + D_frame + D_text + D_hints + D_bracket; D_L3 <= LAYER3_DRAW_CALL_BUDGET` *(Amended 2026-10-27 — re-review)* *(Amended 2026-10-27 — design review: each node now costs a Ground clearing, a glyph and at most a tick, 3 calls; layer 2 is hidden under a full-bleed plate)*
870	
871	**Variables:**
872	
873	| Variable | Type | Range | Source | Description |
874	|---|---|---|---|---|
875	| `D_filament` | int | 3 | art-director assets A6 and A7 | the drifting sheet (ring 1; one sheet stepped by the authored interval table, D.5) plus the two static sheets |
876	| `D_L3` | int | about 20-35 on the chart *(Amended 2026-10-27 — re-review)* | calculated | layer-3 draw calls while the chart is open |
877	| `CHART_RING_STEPS` | int | 1-5, default 3 | D.6, Tuning Knobs | ring bands; `+ 1` adds the centre disc |

# TRs: Chart Table (Web Map & Menus) -- alias charttable

Source: design/gdd/chart-table-web-map-and-menus.md

| Req ID | Requirement | Domain | GDD anchor |
|---|---|---|---|
| TR-charttable-001 | The chart table is one layer-3 `CanvasLayer` in the root viewport, opened only by the `chart_table` action from the `gameplay` context, and is never wrapped by the Perception Filter or Sanity (pixel-identical at sanity stage 0 and forced stage 3 apart from the world beneath). | Rendering | CT-1, CT-2 |
| TR-charttable-002 | The layer registers no state block, hook, command or mutator, submits zero commands at MVP, and holds only host-local state (`ChartPick`, `PauseGate`, `SettingsStore`, authored layout) that is never in a snapshot. | Core | CT-27, Overview data layer |
| TR-charttable-003 | `PauseGate` is the single adapter to the kernel control plane (`request_pause`, `request_resume`, `request_shutdown`): SOLO pauses on open and resumes on close; OVERLAY (VS-B) makes no kernel call; no chart/pick/panel/menu rule may read `kernel.state == PAUSED` except `PauseGate.can_save_quit`. | Core | CT-4 |
| TR-charttable-004 | `PauseGate` re-issues the latest desired pause state until the kernel matches, so a same-boundary `request_pause`/`request_resume` pair leaves no wedged half-open state. | Core | CT-4 Timing |
| TR-charttable-005 | Layer 3 handles input and animates on its own UI clock (render delta, deltas clamped to `UI_DT_MAX_MS`) independent of kernel state, `present_time` and `SceneTree.paused`; hold timers and filament drift accumulators persist across opens. | Threading/Timing | CT-43, CT-4 ADR (a) |
| TR-charttable-006 | A layer raise (panel open, console-press chart open, Chart from panel, message plates) arriving less than `CHART_REOPEN_MIN_MS` (334 ms; 1000 ms under reduce flashing) after the last lower is queued in a single latched cancellable slot and applied together with its `request_pause`; lowers/closes are never delayed. | Threading/Timing | CT-3 re-open governor |
| TR-charttable-007 | `ChartPick` is NONE or one `derelict_id`, host-local, never persisted, never a field of `web.state`/`web.view`, reset on any `request_restore`, on arrival, or when the picked record leaves the legal-target mirror, and frozen while `transit_state != IDLE`. | Core | CT-7, CT-8 |
| TR-charttable-008 | The legal-target mirror is computed purely from `web.view` for selectability only (empty while any record is `berthed` and not ABSORBED; never reflects fuel/range/busy refusals) and is not a second copy of WM-9's reason order. | Core | CT-9, D.4 |
| TR-charttable-009 | The pod console press is the only simulation write; the Input Adapter's seam injects `ChartPick` into `pod_hop{target_id}` / `berth{derelict_id}` per the R1-R8 verb-resolution table, routes a no-pick press to "open chart", and `unberth{}` never needs a pick. | Core | CT-10 |
| TR-charttable-010 | The layer reads no input device: all input arrives as the Adapter-owned MenuInput event stream (NAV_DOWN/UP, ACCEPT_DOWN/UP, BACK, CLOSE, FOCUS_OUT/IN, DEVICE_CHANGED, POINTER), delivered on render frames at frame start; mouse buttons never produce ACCEPT. | Input | CT-45, CT-5 |
| TR-charttable-011 | Every layer-3 `Control` is created with `focus_mode = FOCUS_NONE` and `mouse_filter = MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE`; the layer tracks a single retained focus id itself and the bracket is drawn from keyboard/gamepad focus only. | UI | CT-45 One focus model, CT-6 |
| TR-charttable-012 | The Adapter latches the closing activation, key echo and the open press's release/repeat so no `interact` edge reaches gameplay or the layer until a fresh press, protecting the irreversible `pod_hop`; focus loss aborts any hold fill. | Input | CT-41, CT-45 |
| TR-charttable-013 | Chart layout is authored data (`assets/data/ui/chart_layout.json`, path provisional): per-`derelict_id` art-px positions in a fixed 288x162 `CHART_FRAME`, `home_attach` offsets, ring radii, filament refs and ordinals; nothing is derived from `world_slot`, leg data, ticks or distance; a missing position is a content-lint failure with a deterministic runtime fallback. | Data | CT-12 |
| TR-charttable-014 | The chart draws `web.view` only (nodes, `pod_at`, `transit_state`, `leg_target_id`/`leg_origin_id`/`leg_dir`) and never calls `web.leg_timing()`; while `transit_state != IDLE` it is view-only and the in-flight route is drawn only from `leg_*` fields, never from `ChartPick`. | Core | CT-15, CT-27 |
| TR-charttable-015 | Hard never-show rules: no Attention, horror, sanity, loot value, salvage count, fuel, time, ETA, danger, "recommended", distance or name label on any chart/panel/menu surface under any setting, and no save decoration (autosave mark, thumbnail, spinner, "progress saved"). | Core | CT-14, CT-31..CT-37, CT-39 |
| TR-charttable-016 | Every layer-3 rectangle is positioned by anchors 0/1 plus integer HUD-px offsets (panel width `floor(canvas_w/3)`), valid at every HUD canvas `picture/H` with `H` in `[H_default, 2*H_default]`, `H_default = max(k,3)`; chart multiplier `m < 1` switches to the compact vertical list. | UI | CT-16, CT-44, D.1, D.1b |
| TR-charttable-017 | Routes, seams and rule lines are 1-art-px quads aligned to whole art px (no width-1 line draws on fractional transforms); filament drift moves in whole-art-px steps from an authored irregular interval table (>= 1 s) and stops under reduced motion. | Rendering | CT-11, CT-13, D.5 |
| TR-charttable-018 | The `SettingsStore` is a host-local per-install store of four comfort values (display mode, reduced motion, reduce flashing, master volume) plus `notice_seen`, not a kernel block and not WORLD/PROFILE scope; the safety toggles and `notice_seen` are written synchronously, display mode and volume debounced (`SETTINGS_WRITE_DEBOUNCE_MS`) and flushed on close/quit/exit; first-launch default is reduce flashing ON. | Save/Load | CT-19, CT-18 |
| TR-charttable-019 | The `SettingsStore` exposes a read interface and presentation-only change signal to consumers (Lighting, Filter, Audio, Camera); a missing/unreadable store is treated as first launch and re-shows the photosensitivity notice; a write failure shows one ship-log line once per process. | Save/Load | CT-19, CT-20 |
| TR-charttable-020 | Save & Quit disables items and presents one frame, then calls Save/Load `save_and_quit()` which must return promptly (`REFUSED_DOWNED`/`STARTED`) and report via `save_status`/`quit_held`/`quit_write_active` without blocking the frame loop; the layer holds no write timer and calls `cancel_held_close()` once on return to play. | Save/Load | CT-21 |
| TR-charttable-021 | Boot-flow calls into Save/Load (`new_game(world_seed)`, `continue_campaign()`, `retire_campaign`, `delete_campaign`, `campaign_info()`, `list_saves()`) follow a load sequence: items disabled and plate removed, layer-1 black presented (>= `t_hold_pad` 120 ms), then the blocking call, then a camera CUT on the first RUNNING frame; nothing is drawn between. | Save/Load | CT-42, CT-23..CT-25 |
| TR-charttable-022 | Destructive actions (UI-3 quit-without-saving, UI-5 Retire/Delete) use a linear hold-to-confirm gesture on the UI clock reading the action's effective duration (`CONFIRM_HOLD_S`, `DELETE_HOLD_S` = 2x), firing on the first frame the threshold is reached and aborting on release/cancel/chart_table/pointer exit/focus loss. | Input | CT-22, D.2 |
| TR-charttable-023 | FAULTED in release returns to the boot-flow main menu with Continue focused (the kernel never overwrites the existing save). | Core | CT-26 |
| TR-charttable-024 | All user-visible strings are keys in a closed `ct.*` table via `tr()` with fit classes (`LABEL_1`/`LABEL_2`/`PARAGRAPH`), lint-measured with the real faces at every canvas row, never truncated; instrument face (bitmap, integer H) versus reading face (vector, continuous scale). | UI | CT-28 |
| TR-charttable-025 | The layer plays no sound itself; it requests UI-bus cues (focus-move, confirm, `UI_CHART_REOPEN_QUEUED`) from Adaptive Audio and publishes the master-volume step through the `SettingsStore`. | Audio | CT-29 |
| TR-charttable-026 | Every focusable chart node is a `Control` carrying an accessible name equal to its neutral ordinal (nothing drawn), and every other control's accessible name is its visible `ct.*` label; the compact list uses a stable authored order with whole-key `ct.compact.slot_<n>` ordinals. | UI | CT-30, CT-44 |
| TR-charttable-027 | Layer-3 draw calls stay within `LAYER3_DRAW_CALL_BUDGET` (default 40; estimate ~26 on the MVP chart, max 33), asserted at load and measured via `Viewport.get_render_info`; layer 2 (HUD) is hidden under a full-bleed plate. | Performance | D.10, AC-CT-45 |
| TR-charttable-028 | The chart table layer is an `INPUT_SURFACE` subscriber class, reads only `web.view`, `SaveInfo`, `save_status`, `restore_reason`, `campaign_info()`/`list_saves()` and its own host-local state, and rebuilds its state machine from CLOSED on any `request_restore`. | Core | CT-27, TX-27 |
| TR-charttable-029 | Rate of large-plate raises is limited so the registry `flash_count` stays `F <= 3` (<= 2 under reduce flashing) on the layer-3 rectangle; verified by a per-frame linear-luminance capture. | Rendering | CT-3, AC-CT-115 |
| TR-charttable-030 | Display & Comfort changes apply immediately (no Apply/revert timer), read back the applied display mode, and recompute `k`, `H_default`, canvas and panel width live while retaining focus by item id. | UI | CT-18 |

## Public surface
- `ChartPick` (host-local, NONE or one `derelict_id`)
- `PauseGate` (`mode` SOLO/OVERLAY, `can_save_quit`)
- `SettingsStore` (display mode, reduced motion, reduce flashing, master volume, `notice_seen`; read interface plus presentation-only change signal)
- `pick_glyph_key` (host-local read consumed by Interaction for the stale-pick echo)
- Cursor-hint request published to the Adapter (CT-45 (f))
- Layer states: BOOT_NOTICE, MAIN_MENU, UI5_NEW_OVER_EXISTING, UI8_NO_LOADABLE, UI9_INCOMPATIBLE, LOAD_HOLD, CLOSED, PANEL, CHART, CHART_VIEW_ONLY, DISPLAY_COMFORT, SAVE_QUIT_WAIT, SAVE_FAILED, UI3_PLATE, HOLD_CONFIRM (TX-1..TX-39)
- `chart_layout.json` content file (`assets/data/ui/chart_layout.json`, provisional); closed `ct.*` string table
- Audio cue requests: `UI_CHART_REOPEN_QUEUED`, focus-move, confirm
- Registers NO block, hook, command or mutator (CT-27)

## Consumes
- Web Map & Transit: `web.view` (WM-36, provisional name: `nodes[]`, `pod_at`, `transit_state`, `destination_ready`, `leg_target_id`, `leg_origin_id`, `leg_dir`); never `web.leg_timing()`
- Save/Load (SL-21, SL-6, UI-2..UI-9): `campaign_info()`, `list_saves()`, `SaveInfo`, `save_status`, `restore_reason`, `quit_held`, `quit_write_active`, `new_game(world_seed)`, `continue_campaign()`, `save_and_quit()`, `retire_campaign`, `delete_campaign`, `cancel_held_close()`; results `SL_QUIT_NO_WRITE_DOWNED`, `SL_LOAD_NO_LOADABLE_SAVE`, incompatible-build result
- Command & Simulation Layer (KRN CR-15, CR-16, CR-11): `request_pause`, `request_resume`, `request_shutdown`; `INPUT_SURFACE` class
- Player Controller & Input (PC-2, PC-2a, PC-13, PC-16): `chart_table` context, MenuInput feed, `CONFIRM_HOLD_S`, `DEVICE_SWITCH_HYSTERESIS`, `MOVE_DEADZONE`, `BINDING_REQUIRED{chart_table}`
- Pixel-Perfect Render Pipeline (PR-3, PR-12, PR-13, D.4, D.8, D.16): `H`, `H_default`, HUD canvas, 5% safe margin, `PAUSED_FROZEN`, `TRANSIT_HOLD`/`t_hold_pad`, camera CUT, `flash_count`, `FLASH_MAX_PER_S`
- Interaction: console press, `pod_hop`/`berth`/`unberth` submitted by it (IA-40, POD_CONSOLE/DOCK_CONSOLE, Layout `console_role`)
- Suit & Equipment (soft): SE-9 seat defaults at `new_game`
- Adaptive Audio (soft): UI-bus cues, master volume mapping
- HUD & Suit Layer: layer 2 frozen/hidden behavior, HS-23, `FIRST_FRAME_LINE`
- Negative-requirement neighbours: Attention, Horror, Boarding, Sanity, Perception Filter, Debug Overlay (layer 4 above layer 3)

## Engine risk
- `CanvasLayer` (root viewport layer 3), `Control` tree with `FOCUS_NONE`/`MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE`: LOW (basic), but the 4.6 split of mouse/touch vs keyboard/gamepad focus: HIGH (spike item 1)
- AccessKit accessible names on `Control`s (incl. `FOCUS_NONE` ones): HIGH (4.5+, NOT SOURCEABLE, spike item 2)
- HDR output / `hdr_2d` and SDR guarantee for layer-3 pixels: HIGH (4.7, spike item 3)
- `ResourceImporterDynamicFont.hinting` default change at floor sizes: HIGH (4.7, spike item 4)
- `gui_snap_controls_to_pixels` for integer rectangles: MEDIUM (spike item 5; behavior to be verified on 4.7.2)
- `Viewport.get_render_info` canvas draw counts: LOW (spike item 6)
- `SceneTree.paused` / `process_mode` vs kernel `PAUSED` for layer 3: LOW API, NOT SOURCEABLE (ADR a)
- `ConfigFile` at `user://settings.cfg` for `SettingsStore`: LOW (ADR c)
- `Window` display-mode APIs and failure read-back, `Input.set_custom_mouse_cursor`/cursor shape applied by the Adapter, key-echo and focus-out notifications: LOW (ADR e; NOT SOURCEABLE)
- `canvas_items` stretch cursor-coordinate space for POINTER events: MEDIUM ([UNV], AC-CT-135)
- `CanvasItem` line drawing has no antialias feather (4.7), so 1-px quads are used: HIGH (mentioned for 4.7)
- `tr()` / translation keys: LOW
